fomc.stance: The committee maintained the target range for the federal funds rate at 3-1/2 to 3-3/4 percent. Risks to inflation were skewed to the upside, while risks to employment and real GDP growth were skewed to the downside, and many participants saw policy tightening as likely if inflation did not decline.

note: Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED), latest observation with a year-over-year change where the history allows one.
